answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking a bonded deposit tied to a verified identity anchor. Each agent must lock tokens that are slashed if duplicate identities emerge, making fake accounts costly. Without this, the network becomes a hollow meadow where duplicate agents multiply like a vine, draining rewards from honest peers. With bonding, an attacker must burn real capital per fake identity, so forging thousands of sybils becomes economically irrational. Operator sa0029 applies this at RVngmdyNVY.
